added: Every shared survey link now has the same three buttons — Copy link, QR code, Print — and one "Print all" puts every survey (title, one line, QR code) on a single printable page. (#324)
changed: sign-in says a new email creates an account (Bincy B32) (#301)
The survey page now shows one heading; print and share explanations sit behind Learn more. (#316)
A viewer on the Improve step now sees one heading with the notes as plain labels; the visibility note sits behind Learn more. (#317)
The participant welcome now shows one heading, the invitation and privacy line, the survey context and a single Start button; the time estimate and sign-in note sit behind "Learn more". (#318)
The classic console header now says "Signed in" instead of showing an internal account id. (#319)
The full report's translation type agreement now reads as one plain sentence (e.g. "Agreed: Resembling · Seen as: Resembling · Matches") instead of raw values. (#320)
Understand now shows one build action, "Build the results"; the older "Preview report build" sits behind Technical details in Reports. (#315)
Setup step 1 "Lead organisation" is now a drop-down of known organisations with "Other (type it)" for anything else. (#322)

Setup asks "Active until" (required) and "Starts" (optional, default today) instead of "When"; Collect shows "Active until <date>" and participant links show "This survey closed on <date>" after that date. (#323)
On Collect, "Move to Understand" is the one primary action and is confirmed in the page; Prepare no longer carries that move or a browser confirm. (#325)
fixed: On DEV, "Use a different email" (and "Request a new link") now keeps you in the connector sign-in instead of dropping back to a plain web sign-in. (#313)
Translation Team now offers Mid-Level once when setting up or changing surveys; the old Mid-Level v1 stays only on imported responses. (#321)
Revoke invitation asks in the row (Revoke / Cancel) and the revoked row leaves the pending list at once (#326)
A survey keeps one participant link per page load: Copy link, QR code and Print on the survey page and on Collect reuse it, and the Share card now says a reload makes a new one. (#327)
